js: const d=document.querySelector('[role=dialog]'); if(!d) return 'no dialog'; const bs=Array.from(d.querySelectorAll('button')); const b=bs.find(x=>/close|dismiss|cancel/i.test(x.getAttribute('aria-label')||'')); if(b){b.click(); return 'closed:'+b.getAttribute('aria-label');} return 'no-close; buttons='+bs.map(x=>(x.getAttribute('aria-label')||x.innerText.trim())).join('|');

const b=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x=>x.innerText.trim().startsWith('Bench Press')); if(b){b.click(); return 'added bench';} return 'none: '+Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).map(x=>x.innerText.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,30).join('|');
